before: An m:nary without m:chr projected, drew, and copied as a sum, and its compact linear text spelled a sum.
after: An m:nary without m:chr projects, draws, and copies as an integral, offers no compact linear text, and keeps its source without m:chr. Copied plain text includes the drawn operator of every n-ary structure.
reason: Only the read-only projection of preserved source changes. Canonical OMML, offsets, operations, and collaboration data remain unchanged, and compact replacement still writes m:chr for each sum it creates.
